headline: Newcastle repriced to 40.4%; goals markets unmoved
summary: The market has Newcastle at 40.4% fair to win at Crystal Palace (Palace 32.8%, draw 26.8%), after a move from 37.5% captured at our 23:16 snapshot on 18 October across four books. The Asian handicap fair line moved 0.12 goals towards Newcastle (0.04 to 0.16), the same repricing seen through a second market. Goals markets are flat: Over 3.0 at 48.1%, fair total 2.92, both teams to score 61.6%. With only 6.5 hours and three price snapshots, the true opening is unknown, and zero injury reports leave no news explanation testable.

voices.scout: At twenty-three sixteen on the eighteenth, four books we track moved Newcastle from thirty-seven and a half per cent to forty point four, the sharp book from two point five four down to two point three eight. Palace went the other way, to thirty-two point eight. The handicap fair line moved zero point one two goals. That's a repricing with a sharp lead, and I think it's information.
voices.sceptic: Careful. Four books, not six. And we took three snapshots in six and a half hours, so 'same minute' is our polling, not their timing. The move could be up to twenty-seven minutes apart. The handicap shift is half a quarter-line, and it's the same repricing seen through a second market, not a second signal. One snapshot can't separate informed money from a soft opening line being corrected.
voices.gaffer: So here's the verdict. Newcastle at forty point four per cent, Palace at thirty-two point eight, one three-point move seen through the result and handicap markets. Goals genuinely flat. Confidence low: six and a half hours and three snapshots is not a full day of prices.
